findings.summary: Deterministic sample check for R1 lists milestones [M1, M2] but omits M3, where AT1 (the cited acceptance test) is integrated into CI; this creates an incomplete trace between the sample check and where the requirement is validated.

evidence.note: Sample check for R1 references AT1 and milestones M1,M2.
M3 deliverable DL10 explicitly includes automated runs of AT1–AT6 integrated into CI.
evidence.quote: Automated runs of AT1, AT2, AT3, AT4, AT5, AT6 integrated into CI for the core pipeline.

findings.summary: Deterministic sample check for R2 lists milestones [M1, M2] but omits M3, where AT2 (the cited acceptance test) is integrated into CI; this creates an incomplete trace between the sample check and where the requirement is validated.

evidence.note: Sample check for R2 references AT2 and milestones M1,M2.
M3 deliverable DL10 explicitly includes automated runs of AT1–AT6 integrated into CI, including AT2.
evidence.quote: Automated runs of AT1, AT2, AT3, AT4, AT5, AT6 integrated into CI for the core pipeline.

findings.summary: Deterministic sample check for R3 lists milestones [M1, M2], but the plan locates implementation of R3 (and R4) in M3 via the Markdown render plugin (DL9); this is a milestone misattribution that can mislead dependency/verification tracking for R3.

evidence.note: Sample check for R3 references AT3 and milestones M1,M2.
M3 deliverable DL9 explicitly targets R3/R4 per-note HTML generation via Markdown render plugin.
evidence.quote: Markdown render plugin producing per-note HTML pages for all non-excluded notes (R3/R4).

evidence.note: M3 deliverable DL10 includes automated runs of AT3 integrated into CI.
evidence.quote: Automated runs of AT1, AT2, AT3, AT4, AT5, AT6 integrated into CI for the core pipeline.
